title: SYSU TWSA v1.0: global 0.5° terrestrial water storage anomalies via satellite gravimetry (2002–2022)
description: Global monthly gridded terrestrial water storage anomalies at 0.5° from April 2002 to December 2022, derived from GRACE/GRACE-FO with a joint-inversion spatial downscaling framework. The WaterGAP Global Hydrological Model supplies high-resolution spatial basis patterns, while the temporal evolution of all basis functions is estimated from GRACE/GRACE-FO; additional mascon groups for mountain glaciers and selected large or rapidly changing lakes represent signals that the model lacks. Distributed as NetCDF by the National Tibetan Plateau / Third Pole Environment Data Center.
purpose: Adds a physically constrained (inversion-based rather than purely machine-learning) downscaled GRACE record to compare with other products when interpreting water-storage change over Algeria.

spatial_extent.description: Global 0.5° grid (TPDC spatial extent −180/−90/180/90). Algeria lies within the domain; values over Algeria were not checked.

temporal_extent.description: April 2002 to December 2022; some months contain missing data, which are explicitly indicated in the file (TPDC file notes).

format: NetCDF (.nc), distributed as a ZIP archive of 54.27 MB

variables.name: tws
variables.description: Terrestrial water storage anomaly (with lon, lat and time coordinates)

processing: Joint-inversion spatial downscaling: high-resolution spatial basis patterns from the WaterGAP Global Hydrological Model (WGHM), with the temporal evolution of all basis functions estimated from GRACE/GRACE-FO under a consistent effective resolution; extra mascon groups for global mountain glaciers and selected major or rapidly changing lakes. Inputs listed in the ESSD data-availability section include GRACE/GRACE-FO Level-2 fields (ICGEM), the JPL mascon solution and monthly WGHM outputs.
validation: The provider reports strong consistency with GRACE/GRACE-FO at basin scale, improved agreement with basin water-balance fluxes in smaller basins and broadly better consistency with in situ groundwater-level records (TPDC summary); numbers not summarised here.
limitations: Total water storage anomaly, not groundwater.
Residual GRACE/GRACE-FO noise and spatial structural biases inherited from WGHM may propagate into the downscaled fields (provider statement).
Some months are missing; the record ends in December 2022.
Units of the tws variable were not confirmed from the file; check the NetCDF attributes before use.

access.label: TPDC dataset page (download)
access.notes: Sharing way 'Open access'. The page is a JavaScript application; for 'Open access' datasets the site's code issues anonymous FTP download credentials without login, but AEO did not complete a download, so a TPDC account may still be requested.

algeria_notes: Because the spatial patterns come from WaterGAP basis functions, sub-mascon detail over Algeria reflects WaterGAP's representation of aquifer storage and abstraction. Compare with the JPL mascons and with the Li & Kusche and Uz et al. downscaled products before drawing regional conclusions.

unverified_fields: values and missing months over Algeria (file not downloaded)
verification.notes: The TPDC page renders only with JavaScript; it was rendered in a headless browser to read size, sharing mode, licence, file notes and the citation. The dataset DOI is registered with ISTIC (not Crossref or DataCite); its metadata was read by DOI content negotiation (CSL JSON, Chinese title, publisher 国家青藏高原科学数据中心, 2026). published_date is the schema.org datePublished on TPDC, which equals the ESSD publication date; the TPDC page gives a 'metadata update time' of 2026-02-04, the same day the DOI handle was created.
